## Phase Details

### Phase 18: Calibration Foundation

**Goal**: (sanitised) The store can hold a rebuildable record of observations, and the pure math that turns that record into bounded offsets exists and is deterministically testable, with nothing yet reading or writing it
**Depends on**: Phase 17 (earlier milestone complete)
**Plans**: 8 plans (4 waves, plus 2 gap-closure waves)
**Wave 1**

### Phase 19: Effective Profile Resolution

**Goal**: (sanitised) A single provider resolves the calibrated profile at read time, every consumer routes through it, and with no evidence yet the app behaves exactly as before
**Depends on**: Phase 18
**Plans**: 6 plans (4 waves)

### Phase 20: Notification Scheduling Extraction & Determinism Hardening

**Goal**: (sanitised) The scheduled notification window can be rebuilt safely and repeatedly while inputs shift underneath it, without prompts, without destroying other notifications and without leaking private text
**Depends on**: Phase 19
**Plans**: 5/5 plans executed (3 waves)
**Wave 1**

- [x] 20-01-PLAN.md — (sanitised)

### Phase 21: Probes End-to-End

**Goal**: (sanitised) The user can answer one-tap observations, and those answers become evidence, with wording rules enforced by lint before any evidence accumulates
**Depends on**: Phase 20 (and Phase 18 for neutral reasons)
**Plans**: 5/5 plans executed (2 waves)
**Wave 1**

### Phase 22: Response-Weighted Nudge Selection

**Goal**: (sanitised) Recorded feedback measurably changes which items appear, without breaking the guarantee that the notification and the in-app card are the same item
**Depends on**: Phase 21
**Plans**: 5/5 plans executed (3 waves)
**Wave 1**

- [x] 22-01-PLAN.md — (sanitised)

### Phase 23: Transparency, Reset & History

**Goal**: (sanitised) The user can see what the app has learned, check its reasoning, undo it, and be reminded when the underlying input has gone stale
**Depends on**: Phase 21 (for neutral reason one), Phase 20 (for neutral reason two)
**Plans**: TBD
